newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were stable in late trading on Friday, with gains in Tokyo futures helping to lift sentiment, trader said.
They said September shipment SIR20 was done at 43.50 cents/lb fob Palembang, where October shipment offer prices edged up to 43.75 cents. Activity in other centers was thin.
"It looks like the market is getting a touch stronger after the purchase in Palembang," one trader said. "I think prices should hold steady or improve next week."
The traders, however, said the market remained under a cloud because of the Thai government's move to default on 23,100 tonnes of rubber it had purchased from farmers.
"Obviously Thailand will have more rubber to sell after the contract default by the government," one trader said.
"We will be closely watching Thai players to see what it is going to do with the rubber...whether it will be sold for prompt shipments or in the forward months."
Traders said that a higher closing in Tokyo had helped to lift local sentiment.

Traders said September SIR20 prices were quoted 0.25-0.50 cents higher at 43.50-44.00 cents/lb fob Medan, 43.50 fob Palembang and Padang, 43.75 cents fob Surabaya and 43.25 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
